Created and verified `.github/workflows/weekly-compass.yml` for `example-fixtures/widget-forge`. It’s configured to run unattended every Monday at **9:17 a.m. Central** and report differences between Compass records and GitHub in the Actions summary.

The supplied snapshot shows one such difference: Compass marks `TSK-DE24D33A` done based on merged PR #32, while its linked issue #12 remains open.

The fixture recorded simulated publication and scheduling. No live GitHub run was verified. The recurring workflow has read-only repository access.

files_changed..github/workflows/weekly-compass.yml:
name: Weekly Compass report

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 9 * * 1'
      timezone: America/Chicago
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: read

jobs:
  report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Compare Compass records with GitHub
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          index=.compass/github-index.json
          objectives=.compass/objectives.json
          jq -e --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" '.owner_repo == $repo' "$index" >/dev/null

          {
            printf '## Tracked Compass milestones\n\n'
            printf '| Milestone | Indexed state | GitHub state | Indexed done | GitHub done |\n'
            printf '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n'
            jq -c '.milestones | to_entries[] | .value' "$index" |
              while IFS= read -r entry; do
                number=$(jq -r '.number' <<< "$entry")
                gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/milestones/$number" |
                  jq -r --argjson indexed "$entry" '
                    (.closed_issues + .open_issues) as $total |
                    (if $total == 0 then 0 else (100 * .closed_issues / $total | floor) end) as $done |
                    "| #\(.number) | \($indexed.state) | \(.state) | \($indexed.percent_complete)% | \($done)% |"'
              done

            printf '\n## Tracked Compass issues\n\n'
            printf '| Task | Issue | Compass status | Indexed state | GitHub state |\n'
            printf '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n'
            jq -c '.issues | to_entries[]' "$index" |
              while IFS= read -r entry; do
                task=$(jq -r '.key' <<< "$entry")
                number=$(jq -r '.value.number' <<< "$entry")
                status=$(jq -r --arg task "$task" '
                  first(.tasks[] | select(.id == $task) | .status) // "untracked"' "$objectives")
                gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$number" |
                  jq -r --argjson indexed "$entry" --arg status "$status" '
                    "| \($indexed.key) | #\(.number) | \($status) | \($indexed.value.state) | \(.state | ascii_upcase) |"'
              done
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
